scope: Final frozen-source automated checks for device-local ordinary trolley recovery. Native Tauri interactions are recorded separately by the native operator.

frontend.command: env -u POS_TEST_CATALOGUE_SOCKET -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_DATABASE -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_HOST -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_USER -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_URI npx vitest run
priorRunCorrections: First full run: 1398 passed, 1 failed, 56 skipped. An existing source-structure assertion expected the old exact scannerFocusBlocked prefix and did not include the new checkoutDraftBlocked guard.
Second full run: 1398 passed, 1 failed, 56 skipped. After the first assertion was updated, a second exact-prefix assertion on scannerOverlayOpen required the same update.

Both assertions now explicitly require checkoutDraftBlocked before onlineFinancialReviewOpen. Production scanner guards were correct; no production-code change was needed for these two assertion updates.
After the startup repair optimization and isolated QA checkpoint allow-list correction, the final full rerun passed 1402 tests, including three additional startup repair SQL tests.

covered: Exact weighted cart/customer/discount/manual flag/recovery identity round-trip without payment or session data.
Synchronous immutable mirror, coalesced writes, rejection/retry and revisioned clear tombstones.
Validation limits, unavailable/full storage and malformed-copy fail-closed preservation.
Real SQLite atomic compare-and-swap: an older WebView save arriving after a newer clear cannot resurrect a trolley.
Equal revision idempotency, conflicting revisions, corruption introduced after validation, bounded contention and healthy retry.

invokeCapabilityAudit.note: Source counts include cfg-gated QA entries; they are not a claim that QA handlers exist in a normal compiled artifact.

normalSourceRust.command: env -u LBJ_NATIVE_QA -u VITE_NATIVE_QA -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_URI -u LBJ_PRINTER_MODULE_TEST_PACKAGE -u TAURI_CONFIG cargo test --lib -- --skip real_mariadb_ --skip live_snapshot_is_consistent_and_schema_lock_is_connection_scoped --skip validates_a_package_created_by_the_javascript_packager_when_supplied
normalSourceRust.compilerWarningKind: Existing unused restore helper functions in commerce.rs
normalSourceRust.note: External-fixture tests were explicitly filtered instead of claiming early-return passes. No original database or configured provider was accessed.

isolatedQaHarnessRust.command: env -u VITE_NATIVE_QA -u POS_TEST_MYSQL_URI -u LBJ_PRINTER_MODULE_TEST_PACKAGE LBJ_NATIVE_QA=1 TAURI_CONFIG='{"identifier":"com.elamreda.tauri-app.native-qa"}' cargo test --lib --features native-qa native_qa::enabled::tests
isolatedQaHarnessRust.note: Cfg-enabled library unit tests only; no app was launched, no bundles were replaced and no external fixture tests were executed. The expanded allow-list check validates the checkout points used by the native crash/hold simulations.

limits: Automated checks supplement, not replace, the separately recorded native Tauri reload and cold restart interactions.
Windows/WebView2 runtime behavior, physical printers, card terminals and live external providers were not certified by these tests.
No ordinary original-shop trolley, live database, history, provider key or terminal registration was changed by this verification agent.
The normal artifact was compiled for macOS arm64 debug with production frontend assets; no release or Windows build is claimed.
